criterion: Maximum arithmetic mean final equity over8 equal-weight official series. Tie: higher worst final, lower max drawdown, lower X, lower Y.
rule: Choose X in stage1, freeze it, then compare five Y candidates. No changing either grid after results.

common.allocation: Fixed episode budget exposure% of equity observed at first entry signal; includes buy fees
common.accumulation: While still inside buy band, buy remaining budget in orders<=63; stop adding once outside band or budget exhausted
common.liquidation: Latch sell after first exit signal and drain inventory in orders<=63 even if price leaves exit band
common.reentry: After flat, wait until price<=buy threshold again; no added cooldown
common.execution: Every request executes next tick; price gaps may exceed the observed-price budget
common.horizon: No date/ticker/future values, no end-of-series sale, no retirement threshold
common.risk: No separate stop/trailing/TP based on profit; exit is absolute normalized price band

scope: Coordinate tuning on the same8 known official inputs, not independent validation. No recreated series tested.
